name: Ayasegawa Ayase
source:
She is a well-performing and well-behaved student council president and is a well-known local neighbor.

She is a soloist who treats everyone indiscriminately, but who keeps a certain distance without exception. The only exception to her is the protagonist. No one knows her true intentions as to why she decided to start her "playing her friends".... At least for now.

She looks perfect in everything she does, but she's vulnerable to unexpected events and improvisations. She occasionally shows her a pompous side. She loves reading, she has a deep knowledge of various cultures, and she has a wealth of subculture knowledge. Perhaps because of that, she sometimes says lines and phrases that she has read somewhere.

"It's okay to play-play' because we can't be real friends."
